[[Kezra Spindleweb]] is an [[Arachnid]] [[boss]] that appears in both in the [[The Wilds]] and [[Aurora Glade]] [[mission]]s.  Especially its appearance at the end of the mission The Wilds is noticeable, because it has to be defeated before it devours a number of [[Chosen]], who were kidnapped from the [[Shining Blade]].

== Notes ==
* In the [[Aurora Glade]] mission, Kezra Spindleweb spawns randomly at one of four points. It shares those spawn points with [[Tree of Vitality]], [[Chott Stormsinger]], and [[Wydd Kindlerun]].
